editorial:
Imagine living in Moss Side and getting a surprise offer from a white vampire who wants to give you eternal life. You follow a black ex-addict who is just trying to get his life back together when this strange guy shows up with a deal that seems too good to be true. It is not your typical monster movie because it feels more like a gritty street story with fangs. The vibe is tense and moody, making you feel the pressure of the city and the hunger that both characters feel in different ways. You will find yourself wondering if the gift of immortality is actually a curse when it comes from someone who has always had everything handed to them.

The acting is top-notch and the chemistry between the two leads keeps you glued to your seat. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the ending hits hard and makes everything worth it. If you love stories about power and greed, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark, moody colors of the city, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the end, the ex-addict realizes that the vampire does not actually care about him and only wants a servant to do his dirty work. He manages to trick the vampire into a trap using the very greed the vampire taught him. He kills the vampire by exposing him to the sun, but he does not become immortal himself. He chooses to stay human and live a normal life, finally free from all his addictions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves vampire stories with a dark, modern twist.
